items.name: Claude Fable

items.name: MiniMax M

items.name: Claude Opus

items.why_en: Excels in coding, long-document processing, and agentic tasks, serving as Anthropic's most intelligent Opus model and surpassing GPT-5.5 on the Artificial Analysis leaderboard.

items.name: Gemini
items.why: 以四倍於前代 Gemini 的速度提供旗艦級性能，並在編碼和代理基準測試中優於 Gemini 3.1 Pro，是多模態應用的最佳選擇。

items.name: Qwen
items.why: 阿里巴巴的旗艦模型，專為長週期代理工作流程設計，在編碼、辦公自動化和生產力任務方面表現突出，並具有 100 萬 token 的上下文窗口。
items.why_en: Alibaba's flagship model designed for long-horizon agentic workflows, excelling in coding, office automation, and productivity tasks, featuring a 1 million token context window.

items.name: Meshy
items.why: 提供先進的 AI 自動綁骨與動畫功能，將 3D 模型快速轉化為可動角色。
items.why_en: Offers advanced AI auto-rigging and animation features, rapidly transforming 3D models into animatable characters.

items.name: Flow Studio
items.why: 透過 AI 自動化綁骨與神經層技術，大幅簡化 3D 角色從靜態模型到動畫的流程。
items.why_en: Significantly streamlines the 3D character workflow from static models to animation using AI-powered auto-rigging and Neural Layer technology.

items.name: Tripo
items.why: 透過 UniRig 框架提供通用型 AI 自動綁骨，支援多樣化 3D 模型並持續優化。
items.why_en: Provides universal AI auto-rigging via the UniRig framework, supporting diverse 3D models with continuous optimization.

items.name: Cascadeur
items.why: 結合物理模擬與 AI 輔助工具，提供獨特的自動擺姿與 Root Motion 系統，簡化動畫流程。
items.why_en: Combines physics simulation with AI-assisted tools, offering unique AutoPosing and Root Motion systems to streamline animation workflows.

categories.name: 創建聲音特效
categories.subtitle: SFX / 語音 / 音樂 · 例如 ElevenLabs

overall.name: ElevenLabs SFX v2 + v3 voice
overall.why: 遊戲音訊最全:文字轉 SFX(30s、可無縫循環)+ 頂級語音
overall.why_en: Most complete game-audio stack: text-to-SFX (30s, seamless loops) + top-tier voice

overall.name: Stable Audio 3
overall.why: 開源,音樂 + SFX/foley 統一,適合自架 pipeline
overall.why_en: Open-source; unified music + SFX/foley; great for self-hosted pipelines

overall.name: ElevenLabs Music v2
overall.why: 商用授權清晰,可在曲中嵌 SFX、中途換曲風
overall.why_en: Clear commercial licensing; embed SFX in tracks, mid-track genre switch

overall.name: Suno v5.5
overall.why: 消費級音樂龍頭,語音擷取、自訂模型
overall.why_en: Consumer music leader; voice capture, custom models

overall.name: Lyria 3 Pro
overall.why: 最長 3 分鐘結構化曲目,SynthID 浮水印
overall.why_en: Up to 3-min structured tracks; SynthID watermark

monthly.note: 本月不足 5 個新發佈,故以近期(近 30 天)發佈的 Stable Audio 3.0 補足。
monthly.note_en: Fewer than 5 new releases this month, so Stable Audio 3.0 from the past 30 days was included to complete the list.

items.name: ElevenLabs Music
items.why: 正式發佈的音樂生成模型，提供高品質、多風格的音樂創作能力。
items.why_en: Officially released music generation model, offering high-quality and multi-genre music creation capabilities.

items.name: Stable Audio
items.why: 推出可生成長達 6 分鐘音樂的新模型家族，並具備音訊轉音訊功能，其中三款為開源模型。
items.why_en: Released a new family of models capable of generating music up to 6 minutes long, with audio-to-audio capabilities, three of which are open-weight.

items.name: MAI-Voice-1
items.why: 微軟推出的語音生成模型，能在一秒內生成 60 秒音訊，並可從數秒樣本創建自訂語音。
items.why_en: Microsoft's new voice generation model, capable of generating 60 seconds of audio in 1 second and creating custom voices from a few seconds of samples.

items.name: AI Talker
items.why: 憑藉其基於提示的語音設計技術和創作者導向方法，被評為 2026 年最佳 AI 語音生成器。
items.why_en: Recognized as the Best AI Voice Generator of 2026 for its prompt-based voice design technology and creator-focused approach.

items.name: Suno Platform Updates
items.version: Song Editor, Stem Extraction, Extended Uploads, Creative Sliders
items.why: 推出歌曲編輯器、音軌分離、擴展上傳和創意滑塊等功能，顯著提升音樂創作的控制力。
items.why_en: Introduced features like Song Editor, Stem Extraction, Extended Uploads, and Creative Sliders, significantly enhancing music creation control.

categories.name: AI 工具組合 Combo
categories.subtitle: 依社群熱度 Top10 · 例如 Claude + Obsidian
categories.subtitle_en: By popularity, Top 10 · e.g. Claude + Obsidian

overall.name: Cursor + Claude Code + GitHub Copilot
overall.why: 主流「出貨」編程組合:IDE agent + 終端 agent 並用;1.8M Copilot 開發者、~半數財星500用 Cursor
overall.why_en: The dominant 'ship software' coding stack; 1.8M Copilot devs, ~half of Fortune 500 on Cursor

overall.name: Claude Code + GitHub + Vercel
overall.why: prompt→push→自動部署上線;官方 Vercel 外掛(你正在用的)
overall.why_en: prompt→push→auto-deploy live; official Vercel plugin (the one you use)

overall.name: n8n + LLM (OpenAI/Claude) + MCP
overall.why: 可自架的視覺化 AI agent/工作流自動化;191k stars、$2.5B 估值
overall.why_en: Self-hosted visual AI-agent/workflow automation; 191k stars, $2.5B valuation

overall.name: ComfyUI + Flux / Suno / ElevenLabs
overall.why: 節點式創作流水線:圖→影→語音/音樂同一畫布;ElevenLabs 官方節點
overall.why_en: Node-graph creative pipeline: image→video→voice/music; official ElevenLabs node

overall.name: ChatGPT / Claude + Notion
overall.why: LLM 在你的團隊 wiki/筆記上推理;最常被搜的生產力配對
overall.why_en: LLM reasoning over your team wiki/notes; most-searched productivity pairing

overall.name: Microsoft Copilot (Agent 365) + Claude + GPT
overall.why: 企業多模型調度:「GPT 起草、Claude 審查」
overall.why_en: Enterprise multi-model orchestration: 'GPT drafts, Claude reviews'

overall.name: Claude + Obsidian
overall.why: AI 第二大腦:Claude 讀寫你的本地筆記(你同事推的那個)
overall.why_en: AI second brain: Claude reads/builds on your local notes (your colleague's pick)

overall.name: Perplexity + NotebookLM + Claude
overall.why: 研究組合:有來源的網搜 → 來源紮根 → 深入推理
overall.why_en: Research stack: cited web search → source grounding → deep reasoning

overall.name: Midjourney + Runway/Veo + ElevenLabs + Suno + Descript
overall.why: 端到端 AI 影片:腳本→分鏡→畫面→配音→配樂→剪輯
overall.why_en: End-to-end AI video: script→storyboard→footage→VO→music→edit

overall.name: Raycast AI + Claude / Perplexity / NotebookLM
overall.why: Mac 啟動器當各 AI 工具的黏合層(剪貼簿、片語、MCP)
overall.why_en: Mac launcher as the glue across AI tools (clipboard, snippets, MCP)

items.name: Microsoft Copilot Cowork (GA)
items.why: Copilot Cowork正式發佈，提供多工具、長任務的代理能力，並整合M365生態系統，實現企業級AI自動化。
items.why_en: Copilot Cowork officially launched, offering multi-tool, long-running agentic capabilities integrated within the M365 ecosystem for enterprise-grade AI automation.

items.name: n8n AI Agent Node with Multi-Model Tool Calling
items.why: n8n的AI Agent節點重構，支援Claude、GPT-4o、Gemini 1.5 Pro等多模型工具呼叫，大幅提升複雜AI工作流的自動化能力。
items.why_en: n8n's rebuilt AI Agent node supports multi-model tool calling across Claude, GPT-4o, Gemini 1.5 Pro, and more, significantly enhancing complex AI workflow automation.

items.name: Anthropic Claude Managed Agents (Public Beta)
items.why: Claude Managed Agents推出公開測試版，支援排程運行、安全存取CLI工具和認證服務，實現自動化、重複性的AI任務。
items.why_en: Claude Managed Agents launched public beta, supporting scheduled runs, secure access to CLI tools and authenticated services, enabling automated, recurring AI tasks.

items.name: ElevenLabs Music v2 API
items.why: ElevenLabs Music v2 API發佈，引入基於區塊的作曲計畫，提供對音樂結構、節奏和編曲更精細的控制，強化多模態內容創作。
items.why_en: ElevenLabs Music v2 API launched, introducing chunk-based composition plans for finer control over music structure, pacing, and arrangement, enhancing multimodal content creation.

items.name: Raycast AI v2 Personalization & Dictation
items.why: Raycast AI v2新增個人化設定（Profile, Memory）和系統級聽寫功能，讓AI助理更具上下文感知能力並提升輸入效率。
items.why_en: Raycast AI v2 adds personalization (Profile, Memory) and system-wide dictation, making the AI assistant more context-aware and improving input efficiency.

items.name: GitHub Copilot Enterprise with Custom Knowledge Bases
items.why: GitHub Copilot Enterprise深度整合組織內部知識庫，提供基於專有文檔和代碼模式的AI建議，加速開發者入職與效率。
items.why_en: GitHub Copilot Enterprise deeply integrates with internal knowledge bases, offering AI suggestions grounded in proprietary documentation and code patterns, accelerating developer onboarding and efficiency.

items.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot GitHub Server Knowledge Connector
items.why: 新的連接器將GitHub Enterprise Server知識庫整合到Microsoft 365 Copilot中，讓用戶能在M365應用中直接查詢GitHub文檔。
items.why_en: New connector integrates GitHub Enterprise Server knowledge bases into Microsoft 365 Copilot, allowing users to query GitHub documentation directly within M365 apps.

items.name: Obsidian Obsilo Agent Plugin
items.why: Obsilo Agent插件讓Obsidian更像一個代理平台，支援工具、記憶、MCP和任務執行，將筆記本轉化為強大的AI工作區。
items.why_en: The Obsilo Agent plugin transforms Obsidian into an agent platform, supporting tools, memory, MCP, and task execution, turning the notebook into a powerful AI workspace.

items.name: Microsoft Foundry Hosted Agents GA
items.why: Microsoft Foundry的託管代理服務正式發佈，提供生產級代理的受管運行時，支援多框架和端到端追蹤與評估。
items.why_en: Microsoft Foundry's Hosted Agents service reached GA, providing a managed runtime for production agents with multi-framework support and end-to-end tracing and evaluation.

items.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot Planner Agent (GA)
items.why: Microsoft 365 Copilot中的Planner代理正式發佈，允許用戶直接在Copilot內創建、更新和管理個人任務與共享計劃。
items.why_en: The Planner agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot reached GA, allowing users to create, update, and manage personal tasks and shared plans directly within Copilot.
